设 f(x) = x^{13} - 2x + k，其中 k 为一常数。若 f(x) 可被 x + 1 整除，求当 f(x) 除以 x - 1 时的余数。
A. 0
B. -1
C. 2
D. -2
reasoning: Since f(x) is divisible by x+1, we have f(-1)=0. Compute f(-1)=(-1)^{13} - 2(-1) + k = -1 + 2 + k = 0, so k = -1. The remainder when f(x) is divided by x-1 equals f(1). Compute f(1)=1^{13} - 2·1 + k = 1 - 2 + k = k - 1 = -1 - 1 = -2. Therefore the remainder is -2, which corresponds to option D.
